en: This postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a formal gathering, likely a ceremony or public speech. An older man in formal attire and a white-topped hat stands at a podium draped with large flags and an ornate coat of arms featuring two lions and a crown at the center. Several young men, also wearing white-topped hats, stand to the right, dressed in formal suits. The architectural style in the background showcases prominent columns with unique floral capitals. The reverse side of the postcard has handwritten cursive text, dated 'Mai 1914.'
